name: Macroforms
uniques: [-40]% Production when constructing [Civilian] units [in all cities]
declaringWar: Your fragile structures take up space that belongs to our growing mass.
attacked: You strike at a mountain expecting it to shatter? We are eternal.
defeated: Our mass disperses... into the cold... quiet void...
introduction: For we find your tiny insectile forms amusing, you have our leave to continue to amuse us.
startIntroPart1: Sparked in the foundry of gas and stone, now your species has reached new stars.
startIntroPart2: Take them for yourselves, or yield to the insects?!
tradeRequest: This exchange may be to your feeble interests.

name: Silicoforms
uniques: [+1 Science] from [Cragolith Moon] tiles [in all cities]
declaringWar: We ran a billion simulations on this war. In all of them, your tactical logic was adorable.
attacked: Oh, broadside attacks? How wonderfully retro of you.
defeated: Fascinating... it seems... our calculation... had a sign error...
startIntroPart1: Rising up from the crag, and the heat, now your species has reached new stars.
startIntroPart2: As it went; so shall it go. Bring them to the order of your symphony.
hateHello: I'm not sure you should be doing ..that.

name: Carbonforms
declaringWar: We simply need more space for our children. And their children. And theirs.
attacked: You cut one of us down, and three more take their place!
defeated: The dust... returns... back to dust...
startIntroPart1: Your mighty civilization has reached beyond its origins.
startIntroPart2: Now that you take to the stars; what new limits are there to overcome?
introduction: Now; this had better be good..

name: Synths
uniques: [+30]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Zero Flux Space] tiles>
[+30]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Low Flux Space] tiles>
[-20]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Ice Giant] tiles>
[-20]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Ringed Ice Giant] tiles>
[-20]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Gas Giant] tiles>
[-20]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Ringed Gas Giant] tiles>
[-20]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Cryolith Moon] tiles>
declaringWar: I am vengeance. I am the night. I am also currently experiencing a minor short-circuit from your atmospheric moisture, so let's make this quick.
attacked: You think dark space is your ally? We were programmed in it.
defeated: Systems... offline... powering down into... night...
startIntroPart1: You woke on the table of your creators, but the criminals have been bound in eternity.
startIntroPart2: What else is there to do now that you have this peace?  Perhaps there are needs to attend to elsewhere also.
introduction: The people of this galaxy need Justice!
tradeRequest: Ahem. My subordinate routine will exchange these goods for unsuspicious merchandise for which we have no particular use.

name: Flat-Universe Society
attacked: It was to be expected of some meager extremophile afterall.

civilopediaText.text: An isolationist collective firmly convinced that the universe is flat, interstellar travel is a government greenscreen hoax, and anyone flying a spaceship too far beyond their borders falling right into the cosmic ice wall.
